title: What will Donald Trump say during midterm rally in Rock Hill, South Carolina originally scheduled for October 29, 2026? Deport / Deported / Deportation
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Deport / Deported / Deportation as part of midterm rally in Rock Hill, South Carolina originally scheduled for October 29, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the midterm rally in Rock Hill, South Carolina originally scheduled for October 29, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the midterm rally in Rock Hill, South Carolina originally scheduled for October 29, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: The Rock Hill rally is confirmed for Oct 29 and nothing suggests it has been cancelled. Trump's October midterm push is built around immigration, and he said 'deported' at his Lubbock rally on Oct 27. Over a typical hour-plus rally speech he very likely says one of the counted forms. The main risks are wording like 'removed' or 'got them out' instead, or a short midday speech.
blind.falsifier: The Rock Hill transcript or video shows Trump talking about immigration only with words like 'removed,' 'got them out' or 'sent back' and never saying deport, deported or deportation, or the rally is cancelled.

final.reasoning: The price is far below my prior, which suggests the rally is underway or done without the word, or that traders know of a recent change in Trump's wording. I lowered my estimate sharply and am passing rather than betting against likely better-informed traders.
